evidence.description: Citations of tool results that support the decision, in the order they were used

reason.description: One or two sentences explaining the decision

cause.description: none for approve and reject; for escalate, extraction_not_success, policy_warning or over_limit

source.description: Name of the tool whose result supports this citation, for example get_invoice

ref.description: Field path or rule id inside that result, for example recipient.tax_id or TAX_CODE_UNSUPPORTED

value.description: The cited value exactly as the tool returned it, as a string
